title.zh: OpenAI给MCP补上云托管：写完就能做成ChatGPT插件
title.en: OpenAI给MCP补上云托管：写完就能做成ChatGPT插件

current_state.zh: OpenAI now lets developers host MCP servers directly on ChatGPT Sites, so a generated MCP can be deployed to the cloud and turned into a ChatGPT plugin usable on web, mobile and desktop without self-managed infrastructure.
current_state.en: OpenAI now lets developers host MCP servers directly on ChatGPT Sites, so a generated MCP can be deployed to the cloud and turned into a ChatGPT plugin usable on web, mobile and desktop without self-managed infrastructure.
